name: Catalina King
tagline: Selected work in spatial design, architectural drawing, rendering, and conceptual development.
description: Portfolio of Catalina King, interior architecture and design student at the University of Idaho: architectural drawing, hand rendering, residential planning, conceptual design and urban renewal.
portfolio_title: IAD Portfolio — Selected Works in 2nd Year Design

home_hero.alt: Marker-rendered perspective of Simba's lair among the Moru Kopjes boulders, under a blue sky

process_flow_text: Every project here is shown the way it was made, not only how it ended. Concept, research, iteration and drawing sit alongside the final design.

about.intro: Interior architecture and design student at the University of Idaho.
about.portfolio_note: The work on this site is drawn from the portfolio “IAD Portfolio — Selected Works in 2nd Year Design,” spanning ARCH 154, IAD 152 and the ARCH 2750 Summer Architecture Bootcamp.
